source: Clerk of the House Roll Call XML (evs format)
description: Maps Clerk.House.gov roll-call XML field names to canonical SnapMetadata field names. Source URL format: https://clerk.house.gov/evs/{year}/roll{rollNumber}.xml

_notes._session: Congressional session (1 or 2). Not currently mapped to SnapMetadata.
_notes._voteFor: Map to FloorVote.VoteFor and Data.FloorDebate.voteFor element data.
_notes._voteAgainst: Map to FloorVote.VoteAgainst and Data.FloorDebate.voteAgainst element data.
_notes._voteAbstain: Map to FloorVote.VoteAbstain and Data.FloorDebate.voteAbstain element data.
_notes.position_values: Clerk reports 'Yea'/'Nay'/'Not Voting'. Normalise 'Yea' → 'For', 'Nay' → 'Against' for FloorSpeaker.Position.
_notes.contentKey_convention: Use 'bill:{billId}' pattern matching Congress.gov mapping. Source URL goes into snap sources array and element Provenance.url.
_notes.date_format: Clerk returns 'DD-MMM-YYYY' (e.g. '21-May-2026'). Normalise to ISO-8601 'YYYY-MM-DD' for SnapMetadata.VoteDate.
